spec.name: Furniture Spooky Candle Cluster
spec.description: Five cream and dusky purple candles of staggered heights, with chunky wax drips and stepped amber flames, gathered in a low dark iron tray. A compact, cozy-spooky tabletop decoration with a grounded vanilla silhouette.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: cluster of five different-height cream and purple candles with chunky dripping wax, amber voxel flames and a low dark iron tray; cozy spooky tabletop decoration. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..16, y=0..16, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Standing on floor y=0. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
